scope: Export identity map: modules relocate local imports, include_str addresses and declared resource SHA256 literals. Their exact source bytes can be recovered by inverting these rewrites. Artifacts without publication metadata are byte-identical copies; published receipts retain their payload while relabeling runtime paths and declared receipt bindings. target_sha256 and view_sha256 identify public bytes; source_sha256 digests refer to the pinned source revision recorded per row. Modules whose pinned bytes differ across the selected revisions are exported once per byte version: the base version keeps the curated target name, later versions live under H0mework.Versions.<tag>.* with the tag of the earliest pinned revision requiring them; each row records every revision its bytes satisfy (source_revisions).
